cases.behavior: An actual reconcile read with an unavailable player rolls back and releases its shared restore lock; restoring the same player lets the same scheduler-owned document read successfully.
An actual compose using the scheduler-owned request identity cannot create or dispatch a second document or operation.
Repeating the same actual compose request leaves one document, one operation, and one physical command.
An unknown partial receipt stays unconfirmed, exposes no delivery details, and does not trigger a resend.
A seeded forwarded body with multibyte UTF-8 survives actual compose, receipt, and detail read byte-for-byte beyond a preview-sized body.
A pending restore state refuses the actual read; clearing the same pending state permits the same document to read.
Unreadable Background Life participation evidence defers a queued letter and fresh same-episode evidence dispatches it once.
A temporarily unavailable player defers a queued letter and fresh same-episode evidence dispatches it once.
A temporarily unavailable physical form mapping defers a queued letter and fresh same-episode evidence dispatches it once.
A confirmed player identity change cancels the queued episode without dispatch.
A confirmed actor identity change cancels the queued episode without dispatch.
A confirmed physical form identity change cancels the queued episode without dispatch.
Explicit Background Life opt-out cancels the queued episode without dispatch.
Confirmed death cancels the queued episode without dispatch.
A changed episode identity cancels the queued document without dispatch.
A changed restore epoch rejects the stale service call and does not dispatch the queued document.
